basics.name: Nutdanai Jantarawong
basics.label: Senior Mobile Developer — iOS · Android · Flutter · KMP
basics.summary: Senior mobile developer with 14 years shipping iOS, Android, Flutter and Kotlin Multiplatform apps for German, Swiss and Thai clients. Built BUZZWOO!'s in-house RLAX booking app on Android (4.9-star rating, 10K+ downloads, 73 releases), mentors Flutter developers and built the company's AI plugin for mobile developers. Sole app developer of the Royal Society for Blind Children's audiobook app, recognised at Cannes Lions and the Webby Awards.

work.name: BUZZWOO! GmbH & Co. KG
work.location: Chiang Mai, Thailand · Remote with German teams · client apps for brands in Germany, Switzerland and the UK, plus in-house products
highlights: Mentored two mid-level Flutter developers and one Flutter intern through code review, onboarding and project handovers
Built the company's Claude Code mobile plugin for all mobile developers: an iOS–Android feature-transposition skill and parity auditor
Authored the company Android Kotlin style guide and project template (MVVM, Dagger, CI, fastlane track promotion)
Maintained Apple Enterprise signing infrastructure with fastlane match for 16 in-house and client apps
Set up GitLab CI and fastlane release pipelines across Android, iOS and Flutter client apps

work.name: Cenixoft Co., Ltd.
highlights: Built native iOS and Android apps for Thai clients in Objective-C, Swift and Java
Built BuilkSiteWalk, an iOS construction-site app for sharing on-site issues with the whole project team, plus a residence booking app

projects.name: RLAX
highlights: Built BUZZWOO!'s in-house wellness booking app RLAX on Android, shipping 73 Play Store releases (4.9-star rating, 10K+ downloads)
Co-developed SwiftUI features and App Store releases for the iOS app (10.5K downloads in 2026)
Cut Google Play user-perceived crash rate from 11% to 1.5% by triaging Sentry reports and fixing root causes
Integrated Omise card payments end to end into the RLAX Android booking flow
Migrated XML and Fragment screens to Jetpack Compose and built the Home Care booking vertical in Compose
Fixed cold-start, Compose list-key and fragment-lifecycle crashes, then added a startup test to catch regressions
Built in-app chat with Firestore, push notifications, deep links and read receipts
Built a Play vitals tool that clusters crashes and ANRs per build, then fixed the app's largest crash cluster
Modernized the build with a version catalog, detekt and lint baselines, targetSdk 36 and 16 KB page-size compliance

projects.name: Bedtime Donations
projects.description: Audiobook donation app for a UK charity for blind children
highlights: Built the Royal Society for Blind Children's audiobook app, recognised at Cannes Lions and the Webby Awards
Developed the app alone from first commit to App Store and Google Play release (5K+ iOS, 1K+ Android downloads)
Built an EPUB reader that records the user's voice with sentence highlighting, plus an audiobook player with lock-screen controls
Built a custom card-swipe carousel with hand-tuned Flutter animations

projects.name: Youth football training app, pre-launch, Germany
projects.description: Youth football training app, pre-launch, Germany

Co-designed drill API contracts with the backend developer, then built server-driven training plans and benchmark tests on iOS and Android
Authored all 65 architecture decision records, driving choices from server-driven drills and locale handling to error flows
Delivered iOS and Android features in parallel by directing seven Claude Code agents from reviewed plans and ADRs
Reviewed 71 teammate merge requests; median review turnaround fell from 24 hours to under 2 hours after adding automated review
Integrated subscriptions with RevenueCat, StoreKit and Play Billing, plus push notifications and a native video player
Built an error-handling system with an error matrix and dedicated error screens on both platforms

projects.name: DoenerCheck

Fixed shared KMP networking and error handling, including Ktor timeouts, and added unit tests for the shared modules
Added Firebase push on both platforms and set up dev/prod flavors and Kover coverage
Set up fastlane delivery to TestFlight, Firebase App Distribution and Google Play
